es: The Perigon Miami Beach es un condominio en preconstrucción en Miami Beach, en 5333 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33140. Contempla 73 residencias en 18 pisos, de 3 – 4 habitaciones y de 2,100 – 6,700 sq ft.
Equipo: arquitectura de OMA; interiorismo de Tara Bernerd & Partners; desarrollo de Mast Capital & Starwood Capital Group. Entrega estimada: 2027. Precios desde $12,500,000.
en: The Perigon Miami Beach is a condominium in pre-construction in Miami Beach, at 5333 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33140. It comprises 73 residences over 18 floors, with 3 – 4 bedrooms and of 2,100 – 6,700 sq ft.
Team: architecture by OMA; interiors by Tara Bernerd & Partners; developed by Mast Capital & Starwood Capital Group. Estimated delivery: 2027. Prices from $12,500,000.
